items.title: Ray Drummond interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: That’s when McCain wound up getting shot down and all these guys were shot down and POWs and all.

ctx.x: Political science. Decided not to pursue a career in that at that time?

So I was a personnel grunt for them and in the management rotational program, which was very interesting, and you know, a Chicago based company. Northbrook, Illinois.
